scope: Selected AFTA rows 4, 5 and 7: FAU_SAR.1.1, FAU_SAR.1.2, FAU_SAR.3.1; tracked-entity audit review paging and optional filter handling only

baseline_regression.source: AuditController from 5f2db7205f, temporarily restored and returned to the patched source in finally
baseline_regression.interpretation: Six paging/selection assertions fail; omitted optional trackedEntities throws NullPointerException. These are controller regressions, not a deployed exploit.
baseline_regression.fixture_notes: Initial paging fixtures also omitted trackedEntities, masking paging assertions with the second defect. Rebaseline uses explicit empty sets for paging cases and a separate omitted-filter test. Later edits only format the test source.

implementation.paging: Construct a Pager only when PagerUtils says paging is enabled; attach it to query params before the read and include the corresponding response node
implementation.unpaged: Explicit paging=false or skipPaging=true remains unpaged and omits the count query and response pager; existing skipPaging precedence is retained
implementation.optional_filter: Normalize the optional trackedEntities set to empty before UID conversion
implementation.filters: Entity, author, operation, date range and field selections remain forwarded
implementation.store_review: Existing HibernateTrackedEntityAuditStore uses the forwarded Pager for setFirstResult/setMaxResults; it is reviewed source context, not exercised by these mocks

conditions.isolation: Real AuditController, node construction and PagerUtils; mocked query and field-filter services. No database, HTTP/browser or deployed authorization tests.
conditions.dependencies: Offline existing Maven cache. Retains the local unchanged sms-compression 0.3.2 source-build caveat documented in afta-token-owner-binding-2026-11-12.json; no project dependency version changes.
